structures.name: emergency generator
structures.description: The emergency generator's service panel. It's cold and silent, and a red fault lamp burns over the main fuse holder: the fuse has blown. Repair it with a new fuse and a screwdriver to restart it.

structures.name: emergency generator
structures.description: The emergency generator's service panel, its status lamp green. Behind it the generator hums steadily, feeding the emergency circuit.

structures.name: emergency light
structures.description: An emergency lamp on the generator's circuit, glowing a steady white.
structures.unpowered_description: An emergency lamp on the generator's circuit. It's dark: nothing feeds the circuit.

structures.name: power readout
structures.description: The bay's power readout: EMERGENCY CIRCUIT LIVE. GENERATOR RUNNING.
structures.unpowered_description: The bay's power readout, on its backup cell: EMERGENCY CIRCUIT DEAD. GENERATOR TRIPPED: MAIN FUSE BLOWN. Spare fuse in the emergency locker by the airlock.
